about: Request a replacement for a lost or damaged certificate from a permanently closed Dubai private school.
note: Requirements read from the official KHDA service page on the checked date. KHDA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For certificates from a permanently closed private school regulated by KHDA
documents: Accurate details of the academic years attended
fees: AED 120 in total: AED 100 application and AED 20 Knowledge and Innovation
